title: Scenario A — Alert → Root Cause Trace → Hot Span → CPU Profile → User Session → Originating Click
description: Design and entity/ID contract reference specification for RFC 0003 Acceptance #1 and RFC 0006 Phase 6.6 Connected Rail Click-to-CPU navigation loop. Note: The automated Playwright test suite (scenario-a-click-to-cpu.spec.ts) programmatically seeds fixtures directly via the collector API (ensureScenarioAFixture) rather than reading this file at runtime. This JSON document is preserved as an offline design/ID contract and documented reference specification.

contractMetadata.runtimeUsage: unconsumed-redundant-reference (preserved for offline documentation; test uses programmatic seeding)

provenByAutomatedTest: Synthetic trace waterfall hierarchy and span ID links
Connected Rail Down link from span to CPU profile route with trace_id filter
Connected Rail Across link from profile manifest to sampled trace
Connected Rail Up link to user session and Related link to originating interaction ID
Browser UI navigation slice: trace waterfall -> span Connected Rail -> profile detail view
notProvenByAutomatedTest: Live firing alert transition or incident exemplar click navigation
Trace waterfall self-time calculation or dominance
Parsed pprof binary protobuf frame hierarchy or hot function identification
Session replay / rrweb DOM mutation playback

profile.note: Design/spec frames only. Automated test asserts HTTP 200 and rail link presence; it does not parse pprof protobuf frames or prove hot frame dominance.

navigationHopsNote: Aspirational 6-hop UX journey contract from RFC 0006 / docs/ux/click-to-cpu.md. The unskipped browser test verifies a targeted 2-hop slice (hops 2-3: trace waterfall -> span Connected Rail -> profile view) and API rail manifests; it does not prove live alert firing (hop 1) or rrweb session replay (hops 5-6).
